chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from a man of Banu 'Ijl, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a place upon which there is dust, so I blow it away when I intend sajdah. He said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.السُّجُودَ: the act of prostration in salat
key_terms.الْغُبَارُ: dust present on the place of prostration
key_terms.الْمَكَانِ: the place or spot where sajdah is to be performed
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to blow dust from the place of sajdah during salat?
ai.summary: This hadith states that blowing dust from the place of sajdah during salat is permissible. It indicates a legal ruling of allowance regarding a minor action connected to preparing the place of prostration.
